meta.routePrinciple: Nearer the extraction coast where practical; step seaward around headland/shallow-water/tidal sectors; then take the shortest useful water chord.

eventTracking.label: Event live-location link
eventTracking.note: Create/share the event-day link or recipient list with BCC/Barry; do not publish a private live link permanently.

startActions.action: Formal whole-team brief before water launch
Activate live-location sharing with BCC / designated shore recipients and confirm the shore side can see it
Initiate communications with Barry Sweeney — Lead on Land; send route, launch window, headcount and finish envelope
Confirm waypoint-reporting protocol and first reporting gate with Barry
Check event AED / first aid / hypothermia kit
Check VHF, phones, fully charged battery packs and waterproof phone cases

goNoGo.rule: Recheck Met Éireann marine warnings and Sea Area Forecast at final and event-day gates.
Reliable visual control of paddlers and support craft is required.
Carlston signs off actual wind, gusts and direction; ordinary drift/time cost remains operational until control/recovery margin is threatened.

goNoGo.item: Mandatory exits / land extraction chain usable
goNoGo.rule: Verify key candidate extraction points and receiving coast before launch.
Current chart, tidal stream, swell, visibility and safety-boat access must support the chosen line.
No exposed leg without functioning safety cover.
VHF Channel 16 plus redundant emergency communications, charged phones and location-sharing setup required.
Verify first aid, hypothermia equipment and event-carried AED.
Complete accountability, formal launch brief and Barry land-contact activation before launch.

launchScenarios.use: Late window / verify daylight and finish logistics

routeOptions.name: Malin Beg → coastal-access corridor → Muckross offing → Bullockmore → Bundoran
routeOptions.description: Nearer shore where useful for extraction, stepped seaward around headland/shallow-water influence, then efficient open-bay chord. Reporting waypoints RP01/RP02 require land check-ins.

routeOptions.name: Bullockmore → Mullaghmore → Bundoran alternative
routeOptions.description: Concept retained; exact water-only geometry remains to be audited.

routeOptions.name: Malin Beg → Killybegs / Fintra shortened event
routeOptions.description: Northern shortened-finish concept; exact water-only geometry remains to be audited.

routeOptions.name: Malin Beg → Teelin early finish
routeOptions.description: Teelin remains an early extraction concept; exact coastal water-only line remains to be audited.

waypoints.name: Silver Strand / Malin Beg
waypoints.note: Launch. First report to Barry confirms actual water time and headcount.

waypoints.name: Malin Beg sea-room point
waypoints.note: Small initial seaward move while retaining practical shore support.

waypoints.name: Slieve League coastal corridor 1

waypoints.name: Slieve League / Teelin coastal corridor 2

waypoints.name: Teelin outer access corridor

waypoints.name: Teelin Pier

waypoints.name: Northern leg midpoint report

waypoints.name: Muckross west/south offing

waypoints.name: Muckross Head planning reference

waypoints.name: Muckross east / St John's approach

waypoints.name: Bullockmore West Cardinal
waypoints.note: Shared St John's control. Report to Barry immediately after controlled passage.

waypoints.name: St John's Point lighthouse

waypoints.name: Open Bay midpoint report

waypoints.name: Mullaghmore Harbour

reportProtocol.at: Every reporting waypoint and whenever route/ETA/extraction materially changes

timeline: Carlston confirms GO/HOLD/NO-GO for Sunday and selects launch scenario.
Formal brief; live-location sharing with BCC; Barry contact; AED/comms/power checks.

Actual water time sent to Barry; live-location feed confirmed visible.
Conservative pace; waypoint reports to Barry at designated gates.
Time, group, conditions and revised ETA to Barry.

Position, conditions, group state and revised finish ETA to Barry.
Confirm Boat Quay versus verified alternate extraction and report to Barry.
All people/craft accounted; final Barry report, medical check, incident log and kit reconciliation.

exits.name: St John's lighthouse / road end

exits.name: Killybegs Harbour

exits.name: Mullaghmore Harbour
exits.note: Alternative extraction; verify pier/depth/access for selected tide/window.

exits.name: Mullaghmore Beach
exits.note: Additional shore option; verify surf/shorebreak and vehicle rendezvous.

exits.name: Tullan Strand
exits.note: Long accessible beach but not safe for routine swimming; landing only if conditions/local assessment support it.

exits.name: Bundoran Main Beach

emergencyCall.panpan: PAN-PAN — urgent safety/medical/assistance situation not presently grave and imminent.

fields.prompt: Paddle the Bay group / safety boat identity and callsign if assigned.
Current WGS84 latitude/longitude, nearest named waypoint/pier/headland, plus drift/movement if relevant.
Total involved, casualties, people in water, consciousness/breathing where relevant.
Wind, sea/swell, visibility and responder access hazards.
Safety boat, first aid, AED, VHF, PLB/beacon already on scene.
Holding, recovering casualty, drifting or moving to named extraction.

kit: Spare pouch; check seal before launch
Fully charged; keep waterproof and separated

safetyHazards.hazard: Group separation / loss of visual control
safetyHazards.control: Pod/buddy structure, sweep, safety craft and headcounts; stop progression if anyone unaccounted for.
First aid/AED/hypothermia capability, rapid recovery and early Coast Guard activation for life threats.
PFD/BA, thermal system, rapid recovery, dry/hypothermia kit and monitoring.

safetyHazards.hazard: Fatigue severe enough to degrade safe capability
safetyHazards.control: Cruisy early pace, fueling/hydration, technique/cognition checks and early extraction.
Pre-launch mechanical/fuel check; no exposed continuation without adequate cover.
Close formation, redundant comms/location, and no exposed progression without positive control.
No-go/abort when thunderstorms threaten the operating window.

operationalConstraints.response: Hold enough offing to stay outside troublesome close-in/shallow-water sector, then resume shortest useful chord.
Give extra sea room where routine or casualty recovery access would otherwise be poor.
Use Bullockmore/current chart as shared control and select efficient safe-water line.
Treat as slower VMG/drift correction and revise ETA until control/recovery margin is threatened.
Candidate exits must be verified against tide, shorebreak, rocks and vehicle access before reliance.

escalationPrinciple: An operational constraint becomes a safety hazard when magnitude/context removes group control, reliable recovery, emergency communications, adequate safety-boat access or another required safety margin.

weatherUpdateTemplate.gptPrompt: Update the Paddle the Bay Sunday operating weather picture for the Malin Beg → St John's/Bullockmore → Bundoran route. Check Met Éireann Sea Area Forecast and warnings plus Marine Institute buoy observations. Compare issue/observation times. Summarise wind direction/force/gusts, sea/swell, visibility, precipitation/thunder, trend and any material discrepancy between forecast and observations. Give an operational interpretation of CONTINUE / MONITOR / REASSESS / SHORTEN / HOLD / ABORT, but do not override Carlston's on-water judgement. Cite every current source and state the update time in Europe/Dublin.
